about.title: About Noetune
about.p1:
Noetune is an app that begins with
the life theme that feels most alive right now,
and helps you remember your natural self.
about.p2:
Body and safety,
connection with others,
the power to choose for yourself,
enjoyment,
creation,
and understanding.

From these areas,
you choose the wish that feels closest to you now,
and answer a few short questions.
about.p3:
Noetune is not an app
that analyzes your problems.
It is not an app
that gives you the answer.
about.p4:
It is a tool for noticing,
through what is happening now,
the felt sense that has already been inside you.
about.safety:
This is not medical care.
If you are in an urgent situation,
please reach out to a professional or someone you trust.
